From b7ade35eb53a2455f737a623c24e4b24455b2271 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Kurt Kanzenbach <kurt@linutronix.de>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2021 14:45:06 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] net: dsa: hellcreek: Add STP forwarding rule

Treat STP as management traffic. STP traffic is designated for the CPU port
only. In addition, STP traffic has to pass blocked ports.

Fixes: e4b27ebc780f ("net: dsa: Add DSA driver for Hirschmann Hellcreek switches")
Signed-off-by: Kurt Kanzenbach <kurt@linutronix.de>
Reviewed-by: Vladimir Oltean <olteanv@gmail.com>
Acked-by: Richard Cochran <richardcochran@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/net/dsa/hirschmann/hellcreek.c b/drivers/net/dsa/hirschmann/hellcreek.c
index c4f840b20adf..17d3a4a3582e 100644
--- a/drivers/net/dsa/hirschmann/hellcreek.c
+++ b/drivers/net/dsa/hirschmann/hellcreek.c
@@ -1075,6 +1075,17 @@ static int hellcreek_setup_fdb(struct hellcreek *hellcreek)
 		.reprio_tc    = 6,	/* TC: 6 as per IEEE 802.1AS */
 		.reprio_en    = 1,
 	};
+	static struct hellcreek_fdb_entry stp = {
+		/* MAC: 01-80-C2-00-00-00 */
+		.mac	      = { 0x01, 0x80, 0xc2, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00 },
+		.portmask     = 0x03,	/* Management ports */
+		.age	      = 0,
+		.is_obt	      = 0,
+		.pass_blocked = 1,
+		.is_static    = 1,
+		.reprio_tc    = 6,
+		.reprio_en    = 1,
+	};
 	int ret;
 
 	mutex_lock(&hellcreek->reg_lock);
@@ -1082,6 +1093,9 @@ static int hellcreek_setup_fdb(struct hellcreek *hellcreek)
 	if (ret)
 		goto out;
 	ret = __hellcreek_fdb_add(hellcreek, &p2p);
+	if (ret)
+		goto out;
+	ret = __hellcreek_fdb_add(hellcreek, &stp);
 out:
 	mutex_unlock(&hellcreek->reg_lock);
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/net/dsa/hirschmann/hellcreek.c`**
   - A new static structure `hellcreek_fdb_entry stp` is added to define a forwarding rule for Spanning Tree Protocol (STP) traffic.
   - The `stp` entry is configured with the following properties:
     - MAC address set to `01-80-C2-00-00-00`.
     - Portmask set to `0x03`, indicating management ports.
     - Age set to `0`.
     - `is_obt` set to `0`.
     - `pass_blocked` set to `1`, allowing STP traffic to pass through blocked ports.
     - `is_static` set to `1`, marking the entry as static.
     - `reprio_tc` set to `6`, as per IEEE 802.1AS.
     - `reprio_en` set to `1`.
   - The `__hellcreek_fdb_add` function is called to add the new `stp` entry after the existing `p2p` entry.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in the `hellcreek.c` file establish a new forwarding rule specifically for STP traffic, treating it as management traffic that should be directed to the CPU port and allowed to pass through blocked ports. This change is directly related to the previous implementation of the DSA driver for Hirschmann Hellcreek switches, as indicated by the fix reference to commit `e4b27ebc780f`. The addition of the STP entry enhances the functionality of the driver by ensuring proper handling of STP traffic, which is crucial for network stability and management.

Here is the root cause:
The bug arises from the lack of a specific forwarding rule for Spanning Tree Protocol (STP) traffic in the Hirschmann Hellcreek DSA driver. Without this rule, STP traffic is not properly directed to the CPU port and is not allowed to pass through blocked ports, which can lead to network instability and management issues.

 static int hellcreek_setup_fdb(struct hellcreek *hellcreek)
 {
 	static struct hellcreek_fdb_entry ptp = {
 		/* MAC: 01-1B-19-00-00-00 */
 		.mac	      = { 0x01, 0x1b, 0x19, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00 },
 		.portmask     = 0x03,	/* Management ports */
 		.age	      = 0,
 		.is_obt	      = 0,
 		.pass_blocked = 0,
 		.is_static    = 1,
 		.reprio_tc    = 6,	/* TC: 6 as per IEEE 802.1AS */
 		.reprio_en    = 1,
 	};
 	static struct hellcreek_fdb_entry p2p = {
 		/* MAC: 01-80-C2-00-00-0E */
 		.mac	      = { 0x01, 0x80, 0xc2, 0x00, 0x00, 0x0e },
 		.portmask     = 0x03,	/* Management ports */
 		.age	      = 0,
 		.is_obt	      = 0,
 		.pass_blocked = 0,
 		.is_static    = 1,
 		.reprio_tc    = 6,	/* TC: 6 as per IEEE 802.1AS */
 		.reprio_en    = 1,
 	};
+	static struct hellcreek_fdb_entry stp = {
+		/* MAC: 01-80-C2-00-00-00 */
+		.mac	      = { 0x01, 0x80, 0xc2, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00 },
+		.portmask     = 0x03,	/* Management ports */
+		.age	      = 0,
+		.is_obt	      = 0,
+		.pass_blocked = 1,
+		.is_static    = 1,
+		.reprio_tc    = 6,
+		.reprio_en    = 1,
+	};
 	int ret;
 
 	mutex_lock(&hellcreek->reg_lock);
 	ret = __hellcreek_fdb_add(hellcreek, &ptp);
 	if (ret)
 		goto out;
 	ret = __hellcreek_fdb_add(hellcreek, &p2p);
+	if (ret)
+		goto out;
+	ret = __hellcreek_fdb_add(hellcreek, &stp);
 out:
 	mutex_unlock(&hellcreek->reg_lock);
 
 	return ret;
 }
